title: echinochloa crus-galli var. mutica
intro: Echinochloa crus-galli var. mutica, commonly known as Barnyard Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. It is also known for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Echinochloa crus-galli var. mutica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
